stem.text: A diffraction grating is used to measure the wavelength of light.
The spacing of the slits in the grating is $1.15 \times 10^{-6}\,\text{m}$. The angle between the first-order diffraction maxima is $60.0^{\circ}$, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a vertical grating drawn as a narrow rectangle, labelled grating, with light travelling from the left in a horizontal line through it. Two diffracted rays leave the grating to the right, separated by an angle labelled 60.0°.

stem.text: What is the wavelength of the light?
